items.title: Nevada grinds out 16-8 win over Hawai'i
items.summary: Nevada got key contributions from a number of players in all facets of the game in Saturday's 16-8 victory over Hawai'i.

items.title: Post-Game Clarity: Nevada Claims a Very Unsurprising Win Against Northern Illinois University
items.summary: Nevada football (4-6, 3-3) traveled to Illinois to face the Northern Illinois Huskies (0-10, 0-6), where they won 28-7 on Nov. 14.  This was Nevada’s first time facing Northern Illinois University since their introduction to the Mountain West Conference in July 2026.  The win, however, was not overly surprising, considering the Huskies’ record this season […]

items.title: All-Americans of Nevada Football
items.summary: Nevada senior linebacker EJ Smith was announced as an AP midseason All-America second-team member on Oct. 15. Due to the season being only halfway complete, this is not true All-American (AA) status, yet Smith still earned his spot among six of the nation’s top linebackers while being the Mountain West Conference’s only recognized athlete. items.title: Nevada hosts Hawai'i for Senior Night Saturday
items.summary: Nevada celebrates Senior Night and closes its 2026 home slate Saturday, hosting Hawai'i at Mackay Stadium.

items.title: Wolf Pack cruises past NIU, 28-7
items.summary: Two first-half Nevada takeaways led to touchdowns, keying the Wolf Pack jumping on NIU and cruising to a 28-7 victory Saturday in DeKalb.

items.title: Nevada heads to DeKalb to face NIU
items.summary: Nevada heads to the land of sweet corn, Cajun potato salad and (seasonal) frozen custard this Saturday as it takes on NIU in DeKalb.

items.title: Pack struggles in loss to No. 22/25 New Mexico
items.summary: No. 22/25 New Mexico marched 56 yards to a 7-0 lead on its opening drive and never looked back Friday night, defeating Nevada 31-3 at Mackay Stadium.

items.title: Nevada hosts No. 22/25 New Mexico Friday night
items.summary: It's a battle under the Friday night lights of Mackay Stadium this week as Nevada begins November hosting No. 22/25 New Mexico.

items.title: Pack drops non-conference finale at No. 7/7 UCLA
items.summary: The Wolf Pack defense stepped up to the challenge of No. 7/7 UCLA Saturday but early turnovers from the offense allowed the Bruins to establish a foothold and slowly pull away to a 27-0 victory at The Rose Bowl.

items.title: Nevada faces No. 7/7 UCLA in non-conference clash
items.summary: Nevada Football makes its first trip to the Rose Bowl Saturday to take on No. 7/7 UCLA, the game will kick off at 1:15 p.m. and air on B1G Network with A.J. Kanell (play-by-play), Brett Hundley (analyst) and Emma Carpenter on the call.

items.title: Ky Woods named Old Trapper Mountain West Special Teams Player of the Week
items.summary: Nevada running back and kick returner Ky Woods was named Old Trapper Mountain West Special Teams Player of the Week, the conference announced Monday morning.
